entities.name: Jijeung of Silla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Jijeung of Silla (437–514) was the 22nd ruler and 1st king of the Koreanic kingdom Silla. He strengthened royal authority and built Silla into a centralized kingdom. On the contemporary Naengsuri Silla monument, his name was inscribed as Jidoro.




Jijeung of Silla played a crucial role in the development of Silla, a kingdom that would eventually become a major force in the peninsula.




His reign saw the consolidation of power, the expansion of the kingdom's borders, and the establishment of a strong centralized government.




The legacy of Jijeung of Silla can be seen in the continued existence of the Silla kingdom, which would eventually be absorbed into the Goguryeo-Tang Silla.




His name remains inscribed on the Naengsuri Silla monument, a testament to his enduring impact on Korean history.
